inline_prompts: For integers A, B, C ( A < B < C ), if they satisfy B-A = C-B, then (A, B, C) is called a fine triplet. You are given a set of N distinct positive integers S = \{ S_1, S_2, \dots, S_N \}. Find the number of fine triplets (A, B, C) with A, B, C \in S. Print a single integer — the count of fine triplets, as a plain decimal integer. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N S_1 S_2 \dots S_N Output Print the result. Constraints - All input values are integers. - 1 \le N \le 10^6 - 1 \le S_i \le 10^6
